sections.description_of_main_ingredients:
Trikatu – Trikatu includes Shunthi ( Zingiber officinale ), Maricha ( Piper nigrum ), Pippali ( Piper longum ). Trikatu is well known for its numerous health benefits. It is very beneficial in respiratory disorders such as asthma, rhinitis, sinusitis, cough, cold etc. It balances the tridosha and maintains the normal functioning of the body. 
 Shuddha Manahshila ( Realgar ) – It is very useful in upper respiratory tract infections. It pacifies all the three dosha and does detoxification of the body. It alleviates all the harmful toxins and makes it free from all the ailments. 
 Katuki ( Picrorhiza kurroa ) – Katuki is mainly known for its hepatoprotective property. It strengthens the functioning of the liver and spleen. It mainly pacifies Pitta dosha and improves digestive fire. It also enhances the function of nerves.   
 Vacha ( Acorus calamus ) – It is very good for memory loss, Alzheimer disease, anxiety, depression and other psychosomatic disorders. It improves the function of nerves and strengthens the CNS. 

 Method of Preparation 

 Make a fine powder of above drugs. 
 Give proper frolement with cow’s urine. 
 Make suppositories of this mixture and let them dry. 
 Kept these suppositories in a glass container. 

 Medicinal Properties 
 Unmada bhanjani vatika is a herbo-mineral composition. This Ayurvedic formulation is good for psychological disorders. It improves brain function by providing strength to the nervous system.

Unmada Bhanjani Vatika 
 Reference – Bhaishajya-Ratnavali Unmadrogadhikar 504/31-34 
 Introduction 
 Unmada bhanjani vatika is an Ayurvedic formulation. It is a herbo-mineral composition. It contains ingredients which are helpful in treating mental disorders and fever. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Shunthi ( Zingiber officinale ) 
 Maricha ( Piper nigrum ) 
 Pippali ( Piper longum ) 
 Shuddha Manahshila ( Realgar ) 
 Saindhav Lavan ( Rock salt ) 
 Katuki ( Picrorhiza kurroa ) 
 Vacha ( Acorus calamus ) 
 Shirishbeej (Seeds of Albizia lebbeck ) 
 Hingu ( Ferula narthex ) 
 Shwet Sarson ( Brassica nigra ) 
 Karanjbeej (Seeds of Millettia pinnata ) 
 Kabutar Ka Beeth ( Pigeon poop ) 
 
 Description of Main Ingredients 
 
 Trikatu – Trikatu includes Shunthi ( Zingiber officinale ), Maricha ( Piper nigrum ), Pippali ( Piper longum ). Trikatu is well known for its numerous health benefits. It is very beneficial in respiratory disorders such as asthma, rhinitis, sinusitis, cough, cold etc. It balances the tridosha and maintains the normal functioning of the body. 
 Shuddha Manahshila ( Realgar ) – It is very useful in upper respiratory tract infections. It pacifies all the three dosha and does detoxification of the body. It alleviates all the harmful toxins and makes it free from all the ailments. 
 Katuki ( Picrorhiza kurroa ) – Katuki is mainly known for its hepatoprotective property. It strengthens the functioning of the liver and spleen. It mainly pacifies Pitta dosha and improves digestive fire. It also enhances the function of nerves.   
 Vacha ( Acorus calamus ) – It is very good for memory loss, Alzheimer disease, anxiety, depression and other psychosomatic disorders. It improves the function of nerves and strengthens the CNS. 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 Make a fine powder of above drugs. 
 Give proper frolement with cow’s urine. 
 Make suppositories of this mixture and let them dry. 
 Kept these suppositories in a glass container. 
 
 Medicinal Properties 
 Unmada bhanjani vatika is a herbo-mineral composition. This Ayurvedic formulation is good for psychological disorders. It improves brain function by providing strength to the nervous system.

 How to Apply

 Cautions 
 Apply this under the medical supervision. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
